contract.support: configured ages1..260 every state; oracle disabled
contract.selection: same48/16 observations; best marginal validation LL separately per initialization; stronger factor on tie; no outer data or truth
contract.warm_start: three unpenalized EM updates with the same positive pseudocount; learn only from each fit's own training observations; reuse inner warm state across factors
contract.gates: unchanged positive heldout gain and each-state PMF TV<=0.12; numerical checks separate
contract.limits: short single fresh seed, known nuisance parameters; no large-sample/multi-seed/production/Trading acceptance
